allowed_search_space.description: Create and calibrate the shared manifest-driven evaluator without modifying legacy evaluator evidence.
Create the no-privilege recurrent visual baseline and its frozen training configuration.
Create asymmetric privileged-Critic variants while keeping Actor inputs, evaluator, reward, and environment fixed.

comparison_scope: same truth, degradation, and detector manifests
baseline_contract.description: A recurrent PPO Actor-Critic trained without target_vector in either Actor or Critic, using only vehicle state and duck_vision history under the same training and evaluation manifests as the candidate.

central_claim.evaluation_scope: Paired truth, synthetic degraded-truth, and frozen FastSAM rollouts with identical dynamics, rewards, seeds, wind, obstacles, and training budget.
central_claim.statement: An asymmetric recurrent Actor-Critic whose Actor excludes target truth improves paired safe task success over a recurrent pure-vision PPO baseline without increasing collision rate.

evaluator_spec.input_contract: One immutable manifest binds baseline and candidate policy hashes, environment and reward config, truth/degraded/FastSAM perception modes, paired seeds, episode counts, and bootstrap settings.
evaluator_spec.output_contract: Strict JSON binds the input manifest hash and reports raw per-seed episode outcomes, all declared metrics, paired confidence intervals, environment identity, and produced artifact hashes.

experiment_plan.expected_observation: Adversarial fixtures detect any environment, reward, seed, policy, or observation difference outside the declared perception path.
experiment_plan.hypothesis: A single manifest-driven evaluator can make truth, synthetic degradation, and FastSAM differ only in the declared perception path.
experiment_plan.intervention: Implement paired-seed evaluation, raw episode output, observation-leakage conformance, and regression fixtures before any method experiment.

experiment_plan.expected_observation: The baseline produces complete per-seed truth, degraded-truth, and FastSAM outcomes with calibrated variance.
experiment_plan.hypothesis: A recurrent Actor with vehicle state and visual history only can be trained reproducibly under the unified evaluator.
experiment_plan.intervention: Create and train the recurrent no-privilege baseline across the frozen seed manifest without changing dynamics, rewards, or evaluator settings.

controls: same Actor inputs and recurrent capacity
same PPO family and training steps
experiment_plan.expected_observation: The paired safe-success confidence interval improves while collision and information-leakage guardrails remain satisfied.
experiment_plan.hypothesis: Adding target truth, obstacle distance, and wind parameters to the Critic only improves the recurrent visual Actor's safe task success.
experiment_plan.intervention: Train an asymmetric recurrent Actor-Critic with identical Actor architecture and budget while adding privileged features only to the Critic.

experiment_plan.expected_observation: The detector-retention lower confidence bound remains at or above the frozen guardrail for the candidate.
experiment_plan.hypothesis: Temporal visual memory preserves at least 65 percent of truth-perception safe success under the frozen FastSAM condition.
experiment_plan.intervention: Evaluate the accepted baseline and asymmetric candidate under matched latency, dropout, occlusion, and FastSAM manifests without retraining on evaluation seeds.

problem_statement: Determine whether privileged critic information can improve a deployable fixed-wing target-approach policy whose Actor uses only onboard vision history and vehicle state, without degrading safety under wind, temporary occlusion, obstacles, and detector errors.

evidence_refs.supports: The current Actor observation concatenates target_vector with attitude and duck_vision, proving privileged target leakage.
The current trainer already records collision, success-with-avoidance, timeout, and reward-hacking signals.
A truth-path evaluator exists, but it is not a frozen shared comparison interface.
A detector-path evaluator exists but carries configuration differences that prevent direct causal comparison.
Preliminary related work for privileged-information visual navigation; exact task comparability remains to be audited.
Preliminary fixed-wing target-tracking comparator using a different perception-control stack; reproducibility remains to be audited.

related_work_gap.statement: The current evidence suggests a gap at the intersection of asymmetric privileged training, recurrent onboard-only perception, fixed-wing forward-flight constraints, and controlled truth-to-detector degradation; novelty remains provisional until the frozen literature and comparator audit is complete.

source.source_summary: Compile privileged-to-perceptual fixed-wing target approach under wind, occlusion, obstacles, and detector degradation into a falsifiable research contract.

stop_rules.condition: The unified evaluator cannot isolate perception-path differences without changing dynamics, rewards, observations, or seeds.
All frozen asymmetric variants meet any claim falsification condition after satisfying the minimum seed rule.
Evidence requires changing the claim, baseline, metrics, evaluator interface, search space, experiment graph, budget, or stop rules.
The frozen literature and comparator audit finds a directly comparable method that removes the claimed gap.
